concerns.text: Task T015 (Propensity Score Matching) is marked as depending on T011a and T014, but T012 (Code Block Extraction) is listed as a prerequisite for T014 (Static Complexity Metrics) and T013 (Tagging). T012 is currently marked incomplete/unimplemented. T015 cannot execute without the code blocks extracted in T012. The dependency chain T012 -> T014 -> T015 is broken.

Task T017b (Calculate classifier precision/recall) depends on T017a (Ground truth selection). However, T017b also implicitly requires the output of T013 (Tagging) to compare predicted labels against ground truth. T013 is marked incomplete. The data flow for the ground truth validation loop is broken.

Task T020 (Load matched_pairs.csv) depends on T015. T021 (Bug fix latency) and T022 (Code churn) depend on T020. However, T021 and T022 are marked incomplete. The longitudinal metric extraction pipeline (US2) is blocked by missing implementations in T021/T022, preventing US3 from starting.

Task T029b (Sensitivity Analysis) depends on T017b (Classifier metrics). T017b is marked incomplete. T029b cannot proceed without the precision/recall values from T017b. The dependency chain for the sensitivity analysis is broken.
Task T026 (Load metrics_longitudinal.csv) depends on T025. T025 (Save processed metrics) is marked incomplete. T026 cannot execute without the output of T025. The data flow from US2 to US3 is broken.
Task T027 (Wilcoxon tests) and T028 (Benjamini-Hochberg) depend on T026. T026 depends on T025, which is incomplete. The statistical analysis phase (US3) is blocked by missing upstream artifacts.

Task T031 (Post-hoc power analysis) depends on the final matched pair count, which is the output of T015 (US1) and T025 (US2). T015 and T025 are blocked by incomplete tasks (T012, T021, T022, T025). The power analysis cannot be performed.
Task T032 (Generate final report) depends on T027, T028, T029, T030, T031. All these tasks are either incomplete or depend on incomplete upstream tasks. The final report generation is blocked.
Task T033 (Save statistical artifacts) depends on T032. T032 is blocked. The artifact saving step is blocked.

Task T037 (Contract tests) depends on the existence of data schemas and processed data. T015, T025, and T033 are incomplete, meaning the data artifacts required for contract testing do not exist. T037 cannot be executed.

Task T039 (Validate reproducibility) depends on T038a (Validate repro script) and the existence of `data/processed/statistical_results.json`. T038a is incomplete, and the statistical results file is not generated due to blocked upstream tasks. T039 cannot be executed.

Task T005 and T006 are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depend on T007 (Models). The text correctly notes T007 must complete first, but the [P] tag on T005/T006 might be misleading if interpreted as 'can run in parallel with T007'. Clarify that [P] applies only to T005 vs T006, not T007.

T024 might be executable independently if it only handles 404s during the extraction phase, but it likely depends on the full extraction logic in T021/T022. Clarify if T024 can run in parallel with T021/T022 or if it must wait.

Task T030 (Generate visualizations) depends on T026. T026 is blocked by T025. T030 is also incomplete. Ensure T025 is prioritized.
